claim.notes: CFR+ (alternating, full tree, linear averaging), 20000 iterations, exploitability still decaying roughly as 1/sqrt(T) (3.5e-2 at 2000 iterations, 1.3e-2 at 20000). Exploitability and game value were computed exactly by best response over the tree and are consistent with each other. Perfect recall checked. Not converged to a tight tolerance; more iterations would reduce it. Known 6-card Leduc value about -0.0856 agrees.
